what: App Store app previews (iPhone 6.9-inch and iPad 13-inch, portrait), filmed frame by frame from the iOS app in the iOS Simulator: one game tick per frame at 30 fps, so the match plays at its normal speed; every frame is a simctl screenshot of the app
footage_label: Player view of a shared colony (You + Nicowar AI) against AI colonies; the colony was grown by the co-controlling AI, the scripted touch inputs listed per take are the player's. Not human-versus-human play.

build.note: origin/master release commit 5e96273ff62f plus two capture-only patches that never ship: ../captures/mobile/tools/capture-build.patch (compiles the loopback MCP automation listener into the simulator build so scripts can tap the real touch controls) and tools/capture-frame-clock.patch (the capture clock: while switched on over MCP, the match view draws two frames per tick that runs and nothing in between, the presentation clocks advance 1/60 s per drawn frame, and the 'Paused' label an agent's hold would show is not drawn). Neither changes the simulation; with the capture clock off the app behaves as the release
build.renderer: portable SDL renderer (the SDL GPU/Metal renderer devices use is not available in the Simulator)
build.hd_artwork: forced on (highResolutionArtworkChoice=on in the capture profile)

superseded.what: Version 1 (2026-11-25): real-time simctl io recordVideo captures on a heavily loaded Mac; the owner found hitches and stutters. Moved, not deleted.

apple_spec.video: H.264 up to High profile level 4.0, progressive, .mov/.m4v/.mp4, target 10-12 Mbps
apple_spec.audio: stereo AAC 256 kbps, 44.1 or 48 kHz, all tracks enabled

storage: The MP4s are not committed (see .gitignore); they live in ../storefront-v2-renders/app-previews/ relative to the repository root. Their bytes and SHA-256 here identify the exact files.
